products.title: potty training rewards chart and stickers
products.body_html:
Celebrate every win (big and small) with our potty training rewards chart.

Track progress with fun icon stickers and watch motivation soar as your little one fills up their chart. Positive reinforcement makes potty training easier—and a lot more exciting.

What's Included:

  • 1 Potty Training Rewards Chart
  • Sheet of icon stickers
  • 1 Organic Cotton Tote (perfect for carrying spare pairs)

Why it works: Little wins deserve big celebration. Our rewards chart turns every successful potty trip into a moment worth celebrating, keeping your child motivated and engaged throughout the potty training journey.

Simple, effective, and way more fun than a plain checklist.

Our stickers are produced with GreenGuard eco friendly inks!

products.title: boys potty training kit
products.body_html:
Potty training is a journey. We're here to make it a little softer.

Our Boys Potty Training Set is designed to make the transition into potty training as gentle as possible. Little ones learning to use the potty need underwear that's gentle, breathable, and comfortable—especially when accidents happen. Our GOTS-certified organic cotton is free from harsh chemicals, synthetic materials, and irritating finishes that can bother sensitive skin during this transition.

With 4 pairs of organic cotton underwear in styles and prints he'll love, plus a handy tote for on-the-go accidents and a rewards chart to celebrate every success, everything he needs is right here. Each pair features a moisture-control gusset (comprised of 2 layers of GOTS certified organic cotton) to help contain little accidents while keeping him comfortable. 

Each pack includes 2 boxer briefs (one in Shark and one in Pear), 2 briefs (one in Alligator and one in Leaf Green), 1 organic cotton tote, and a rewards chart with stickers.
